description: Part B memory-bridge and Part C T_log golden conformance vectors for konareef-integration-contract/v1. Part B vectors specify byte-exact (index, value_hash, leaf_hash, r_init) outputs per PRD 4 §3.2 (B.1), or named error verdicts. Part C vector tlog-from-db-rows specifies T_log leaf hashes and t_root from DB-row-shaped proof_tool_calls input per PRD 4 §4.1.4 and PRD 1 §5.4.

vectors.description: Single populated cell for thought_id=42, SALT_A, CH_1. Exercises the full B.1 derivation chain: logical_key → index → canonical_cell_payload → value_hash → leaf_hash → sparse root.

No populated cells. The sparse root of an all-empty depth-20 tree equals E[20] = Poseidon_node(E[19], E[19]) iterated from E[0] = Poseidon_leaf(0) (PRD 1 section 5.5, Poseidon over Pallas; 32-byte little-endian Fq). This is the memory-free r_init of konareef-rinit/v1 (R-M10).
Three populated cells (thought_id=1,2,3) with SALT_A. r_init is the sparse Merkle root over the three derived (index, value_hash) pairs.

thought_id=128 supplied with a non-minimal LEB128 encoding (0x80 0x81 0x00 — 3 bytes decoding to 128, where the minimal encoding is the 2-byte 0x80 0x01; the extra septet is spurious continuation padding). PRD 4 §3.2.3 requires fail-closed rejection. The logical_key and index derived from this input are undefined and MUST NOT be used.
pod_salt of 31 bytes (one byte short). PRD 4 §3.2.2 requires the runtime to fail closed with ERR_CELL_SALT_LEN and MUST NOT proceed to index derivation.
Exercises the & 0x0FFFFF trunc20 masking step. be_u32(SHA-256(...)[0:4]) may have bits above bit-19 set; the mask retains only the low 20 bits to yield index in [0, 2^20).
Minimum thought_id=0. Minimal LEB128 encoding is 0x00 (1 byte). Verifies the full chain for the boundary case.
Large thought_id=2097151 (2^21-1). Minimal LEB128 encodes as 3 bytes (0xff 0xff 0x7f). Exercises multi-byte LEB128 paths in the logical_key construction.

Type-C pod: pod_salt is bundle-disclosed (PRD 4 §3.3.1). External verifier re-derives index from the public logical_key. The re-derived index MUST match the authenticated leaf index in the Merkle proof.

Type-D pod: pod_salt committed via h_manifest but NOT disclosed in the public bundle (PRD 4 §3.3.2). External observers cannot re-derive index. Index-binding correctness rests on the documented runtime-trust assumption (PRD 4 §3.8.3 / decision D8). The B.1 derivation chain is identical to Type-C; only the disclosure posture differs.

Pod genesis: two thought_ids derive to the same index under this pod_salt (a genuine collision). The runtime MUST detect this, fail the current salt attempt, and resample a new pod_salt (up to R_max=8 attempts per PRD 4 §3.4.2). This vector documents the collision detection requirement.

Publish attempt with 501 cells exceeds the hard v1 cap of k<=500 cells per pod (PRD 4 §3.4.1). The runtime MUST fail closed with ERR_CELL_CAP_EXCEEDED. There is no grace range, no warning-only mode, and no deferred enforcement.

Intra-lineage capture: thought_id_b derives the same index as the already-occupied thought_id_a under a fixed pod_salt. The runtime MUST fail closed with ERR_CELL_INDEX_COLLISION and MUST NOT silently relocate the thought (PRD 4 §3.4.3).

Part C (PRD 4 §4.1.4 + PRD 1 §5.4): builds t_root from an ordered set of proof_tool_calls DB rows. Rows are sorted by call_index ascending (the sole sort key). Each leaf_i = Poseidon_leaf(record_to_field(record_bytes_i), 0) where record_bytes_i = ULEB128(32) || tool_id_digest(32B) || args_hash(32B) || result_hash(32B) || ts(8B BE u64) || sats(8B BE u64) — a fixed 113 B record (digest tool_ids, decision 2026-07-05-konareef-digest-tool-ids; tool_id_digest = SHA-256(tool_id_utf8), the name itself never enters record_bytes). record_to_field folds the record via the pinned arity-2 Poseidon (0x13 domain+length seed element). The padded balanced tree uses Poseidon_internal_hash and Z sentinel Poseidon_leaf(record_to_field(b""), 0). t_root = Poseidon_internal_hash(len_elem(0x03, |T_log|), tree_root_top). This construction is Poseidon-over-Pallas-Fq (PRD 1 §5.4, amended 2026-06-13); the SHA-256 formulas this description previously carried were the superseded v0 form (§7 generator-gap note). The self-check anchors t_root to a hard-coded constant (computed via the pinned poseidon_pallas oracle, the same discipline PRD 3's fragment:T_log_records vectors use) so the vector is non-circular with respect to this generator.
